text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Back in my room, I leaf through my
resources on Mejiro Ardan.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Looking at her past scrimmages makes it
clear that such a race is
completely
outside her aptitude.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But it's also true her debut,
as well as her racing career, will only be
delayed more if
she doesn't run. I completely understand
why she's so worried.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Suddenly, it hits me. The tryouts are
intended for Umamusume who
are looking
to be scouted.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In that case...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Oh... You want to scout me?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If Mejiro Ardan already has a trainer, she
won't be required to take
place in the
tryouts.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I was already interested in her after
seeing that spreadsheet, so I
don't mind scouting her at all. This way,
she won't have to run in such
a difficult race.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, well, thank you very much for your
interest. I'm truly honored.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: However, I must decline.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, please don't misunderstand. My
decision has nothing to do with
you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I actually plan to reject any and all
scouting offers until the tryouts.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I do hope you'll take the time to stop by
and see what I have to offer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
After all,
I would hate to be scouted based
on anything other than my
abilities.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Not suited for me? Is that it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Then allow me to ask you a question.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
In the Twinkle Series,
will my races always
go exactly as planned?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Of course not. I cannot control every fine
detail of my race agenda,
nor can I control
the weather on the day of the race.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
And what if I were forced to race when I'm
feeling under the weather,
or the track
isn't exactly as I pictured it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
If any one of these many possibilities
were
present...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Should I give up on winning?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Ardan smiles as she continues.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I understand that others may consider
what I am doing extreme, but
well... I
don't.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
After all,
if I allow myself to waver here,
who's to say I won't waver
when it truly
matters?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Once again, I find myself at a loss for
words.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
All I can do is stand in awe of her
dedication.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
My apologies for keeping you so long.
Now then, I must be on my
way.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I hope to see you again...
after the tryouts.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
From that day forward, I would frequently
catch glimpses of Ardan
training for the
tryouts.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Acceleration at the beginning of the race
is vital on the dirt course, especially
when
it's only 1,200 meters...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
In that case,
I shall prioritize practicing my
start. I should also add some
exercises that
help me decrease my reaction time.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As always, she's carefully calculating the
most efficient way to train.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ardan! Um... The tryouts are approaching,
yes? If you'd like, I can
train with you!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
And that can mean anything! I could run
alongside you, we could do
ramps, or
maybe we go for a run around town?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Why, thank you, Chiyono O. I appreciate
the invitation.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Unfortunately, I must decline. I was
actually wrapping up. If I go any
further, I
worry that I'll end up overheating.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ah...
I-I see! I'm sorry if I bothered you!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Not at all.
I imagine it would be quite fun
to run with you. Hehe, I'll just have to
make sure I don't hurt myself in my
excitement.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
What?! A-Ardan... I don't know whether to
be happy or scared
hearing that!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The fact that she can joke about her frail
health astounds me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Days pass, and the tryouts finally arrive.
Due to heavy rain, the dirt course looks
more suited to mud wrestling. I begin to
worry for Mejiro
Ardan...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Raaaah!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ardan! Mejiro Ardan rushes
forward, chasing the front runner!
Will she
catch up before reaching the goal?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff, huff!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Raaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Ardan's reached the frontrunner! They're
neck and neck! And... goal!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
She's done it! Mejiro Ardan managed to
step forward at the very last
second and
win by a hair! Your first-place winner is
Mejiro Ardan!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ardaaan!

text_block_list.name: Student C
text_block_list.text:
N-no way... But I thought she was a
medium-distance runner!

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer A
text_block_list.text: M-Mejiro Ardan, could I speak with you?

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
D-don't forget me! Your race today was
absolutely fabulous. How'd
you like to—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ardan is suddenly swarmed with
trainers—as to be expected after such an
amazing race. But they're making it harder
for me to
reach her!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Wrestling my way through the crowd, I
finally manage to stand before
Mejiro
Ardan.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Oh, it's you...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Hehe... It's nice to see you again too.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ardan falls silent, and I feel her
gaze burrow through me. Just
as I begin to
feel suffocated by the tension,
she speaks.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for your offer. I'm truly
honored.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
And... I accept. I look forward to seeing
where our journey together
will lead us.
